scope: The launcher's disconnect and reconnect with native games (the owner's rule: if the host is lost, everyone saves and disconnects). Two players through the whole launcher (real LauncherWindow, SessionWorker and LauncherSession, a native runtime bundle, production world creation, host enrollment and invitation): both Continue into Littleroot Town and see each other; both walk two steps and save through the launcher (revision 2); the friend walks two more steps without saving; the host's game closes normally, which ends the host's session and world server; the friend's launcher keeps the running game's unsaved progress locally (host_loss_preserved) and allows closing; the friend's game closes normally; the host starts again (revision 2); the friend joins again and its kept progress becomes its next canonical save (revision 3): the game continues exactly where the friend stood; both see each other again, save (host 3, friend 4), close normally; the host store passes its integrity check; source saves unchanged. Ordinary key presses on each player's own X display; direction keys are checked step by step against the game's reported position; the harness reads the games' memory only to see what is on screen and compare parties.

runs.clients: Linux i386 native client x2 (engine claude/native-pc 34ddb17a6: the five crash fixes from the 3D battle branch), started by the launcher's session workers
checks: host enrollment closed each bootstrap game itself (exit 0), revision 1 for both
both games in the field at revision 1; each companion's roster lists both players
both walked two steps and saved through the launcher (revision 2)
the friend walked two more steps without saving (Littleroot 11,17)
the host's game closed normally (exit 0): host session and world server gone
the friend's launcher kept the unsaved progress locally in 1.5 s (host_loss_preserved; pending-emergency.json and pending-export.json; closing allowed); the friend's game kept running until closed
the host started again at revision 2, where it had saved
the friend joined again at revision 3, standing at 11,17 where it had walked without saving; both rosters list both players
both saved again (host 3, friend 4); canonical parties unchanged; running parties equal them
both closed normally (exit 0); host store integrity check passed; source saves unchanged

runs.clients: Windows 2D exe x2 under Wine 9.0, one prefix each (engine claude/native-pc 34ddb17a6: the five crash fixes and XInput loaded at run time), started by the launcher's session workers
checks: the same checks as native-launcher-reconnect-1; games closed with Alt+F4 (exit 0); enrollment's bootstrap games ended by the launcher's terminate (-15 under Wine)
runs.harness: scripts/multiplayer/native_launcher_reconnect_proof.py with the field wait (settle) of the next app commit

failed_runs.result: failed after both saved (revision 2), before the friend's unsaved steps
failed_runs.cause: harness: the game's one-time style hint banner ('Make your own TRAINER look', shown after 12 s in the field) was up, so the field reported busy and the walk refused to start. Fixed: before every step the harness waits for the field to come back by itself (and runs from a wild battle if one starts).

not_covered: a network drop with the host still running (only the host closing was used); the companion does not reconnect by itself after a loss: the player closes the game and joins again, as the launcher says
a host loss during a battle or a trade (separate recovery paths)
the 3D build (a 2D game was used); separate PCs, Wi-Fi or Internet
physical keyboard or controller input and clicks on the launcher window
